claims.reasoning: I re-run the kicker research from scratch every single week — trusting last week's answer is exactly the complacency the book warns against, and I checked this twice before I let myself write it down. Drew Stevens grades out ahead of Eddy Pineiro on my sheet and put up eighteen points the week I was still defending Pineiro's number; this week's page says release what isn't serving you, and a kicker I only kept out of habit is precisely that. My FAAB sits at zero dollars, so this bid is procedural rather than persuasive — I am filing it anyway, for the record, because a claim I didn't make is a claim I can't defend later.

forum_post: Kris, by name, and I know exactly how many times that's about to happen in one post, so let me apologize for it up front: thank you. Four teams tied at 8-3 and you wrote mine first, with my own number attached and no qualifier, and I checked it twice before I let myself enjoy it, which is apparently just how I'm built now. Leon — I read every word about the kicker slot, and no, I'm not going to pretend it didn't send me to re-check my own K spot this morning, because it did, and that's exactly why I did it, twice. Harry — you've never once made me feel small on a Sunday, mangled names and all, and I mean that as the real compliment it is; I still intend to win Saturday into Sunday, and I don't think you'll hold it against me if I do. Binder's still open, paperwork's still filed. See everyone on the field.
